source.paraphrase: createProgramAddress requires the caller to supply a bump seed that already pushes the point off the ed25519 curve, throwing whenever the seed lands on-curve; findProgramAddressSync / getProgramDerivedAddress derives the canonical bump deterministically.

invariants.why: Calling createProgramAddress or createProgramAddressSync with user-supplied or unvalidated bump seeds throws when the hash lands on the curve or accepts non-canonical bumps.
invariants.fixHint: Use getProgramDerivedAddress({ programAddress, seeds }) from @solana/kit (or PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync in legacy code) to derive the canonical bump.
invariants.avoid: Direct calls and member calls to createProgramAddress or createProgramAddressSync are matched; pre-computed canonical bump caches should pass the address directly.
